callees.name: _is_under_submodules
callees.pre_condition: rel_path is a string representing a file path relative to proj_dir with forward-slash separators. submodules is either None or a non-empty list of subdirectory name strings.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when submodules is None, or when rel_path begins with one of the directory names in submodules. Returns False when submodules is not None and rel_path does not begin with any of the submodule directory names.
